text:
Aisha (Docs): Opening a short thread for the relnotes draft for next deploy. Scope: snippet migration follow-up, a few broken anchors, and one streaming edge-case we found in staging. I'll paste the PR link when ready.

Ben (SDK): thanks. Can you enumerate the missing snippet IDs so I can run a quick grep against the examples repo?

Aisha (Docs): sure. From my scan: `snippet:embed-async-v2` referenced in guides/embeddings/quickstart.md (missing), and `snippet:chat-step3` referenced by tutorials/llm-chat/index.md (anchor moved). I'll include paths in the PR.

Cara (I18N): copying in: our localized fr/es branches still link to the old snippet paths; I have a branch with changes but waiting on the final anchor name so I don't have to rebase.

Ben (SDK): I can temporarily add small stub files with those snippet IDs so snippet-check passes while we correct the canonical examples. Will open a tiny PR.

Ethan (Eng): FYI the streaming issue is a corner-case where short streaming batches (max_tokens <= 7) sometimes split the last token across two chunks, which can look like the final token disappeared. We're tracking a fix but it's on the next patch.

Luis (QA): I reproduced it with the canary model using short prompts. Repro command: `./tests/repro_embed_stream.sh --len 5`. I'll attach logs to the PR.

Aisha (Docs): good repro — will add a Known Issue entry. Proposed copy: "Known issue: embed streaming may omit the final token for very short prompts on canary models. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or use non-canary/stable models." Thoughts?

Marco (Docs): that's clear. Add a short repro snippet in the relnotes and link to Luis's logs. Also recommend support triage steps (how to confirm and rollback).

Ben (SDK): sample snippet for repro to include in the notes:
```python
# examples/repro/embed_stream_short.py
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
print(c.embed_stream("tiny prompt", max_tokens=5))
```

Cara (I18N): for translations, let's create a single anchor `#known-issues-v1.0.2` on the English relnotes page and reference it from localized pages to avoid duplication. I'll update the i18n PR once the anchor name is final.

Aisha (Docs): agreed. I'll use that anchor. Draft PR description will have three bullets (change summary, known issues, localization notes) and one example per bullet for the newsletter.

DevBot: PR created by Aisha: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4502 - title: "Release notes v1.0.2: snippet tidy, link fixes, streaming note"

Ben (SDK): starting a quick review. I'll add comments where snippets need stubbing.

Ethan (Eng): if QA needs a staging canary to validate the repro, ping me and I can spin one up for 30m window.

Luis (QA): please do. I'll rerun the repro against staging when it's available.

DevBot: CI snapshot for PR #4502 - docs/lint: pass, snippet-check: fail (2 unresolved refs), linkcheck: fail (1 404)

Ben (SDK): pushed PR #4503 with two snippet stubs to keep CI green. Marked them as TODOs so we don't leave stubs long-term.

DevBot: PR #4503 merged; running checks again. All checks: passing.

Marco (Docs): small ops note for relnotes: include rollback contact `#eng-oncall` and a one-line rollback playbook in the doc in case streaming regresses in prod.

Aisha (Docs): will add rollback playbook and contact. Planning to merge relnotes Tuesday 09:30 PT and post announce after deploy succeeds.

Cara (I18N): I'll rebase my localization fixes after the anchor is merged, then open the i18n PR.

Ben (SDK): left a couple of minor copy comments in the relnotes PR. :thumbsup:

Ethan (Eng): standing by for canary.

DevBot: PR #4502 updated by Aisha - added repro steps, logs, and anchor `#known-issues-v1.0.2`. CI: all green.

Aisha (Docs): merging in 5 unless any objections.

Marco (Docs): no objections from docs side.

Luis (QA): good from QA.

Cara (I18N): good from localization.

Aisha (Docs): merged. I'll publish the short blurb to #product and schedule the newsletter snippet. Thanks everyone! :tada:
